blocks.text: GraspLoop AI
Partner briefing | Fictional teaching material
Reviewed October 17, 2026 (America/Los_Angeles) | KPI data through September 2026

Conditional go: focused founder diligence. No-go for investment approval on this evidence. Paying growth merits a conversation; metric definitions, acquisition economics and the funded deployment plan need reconciliation.
What the data changes
$2.4M ARR / 8x YoY (p6)
$1.932M paying ARR; $2.436M includes unpaid pilots. Paying YoY is 6.57x (+557%).
14 customers / 99.7% success (p6)
11 paying + 3 unpaid pilots. 99.7% is best site, single SKU; fleet mixed-SKU success is 97.2%.
157.14% for the three-customer September 2025 cohort. Broader retention is unverified.
68% GM / 4-month CAC (p7)
September GM is 41%. Q3 net-new-MRR payback proxy is 26.27 months; TTM is 27.87. Actual cohort CAC is unverified.
24-month runway (p11)
Forward plan is unverified. Flat burn: 8.46 months before raise, 33.67 after an immediate $18M raise. Hiring and capex change this.
Five fixes, in priority order
1. Separate paying, pilot, fleet and site metrics.
2. Rebuild actual GM and acquisition-cohort CAC.
3. Tie deployments, hiring and financing to cash.
4. Evidence learning, operator cost and competitors.
5. Support bottom-up market and team records.
Scorecard (1-5)
Problem & insight: 2
Product & technology: 3
Traction: 2
Unit economics: 1
Market & competition: 2
Team: 3
Plan & ask: 2
Four founder questions
Which contracts are paying, future starts or unpaid pilots? Show the revenue/cohort bridge.
What costs and acquisition cohorts support the stated margin and 4-month payback?
What controlled tests show learning, and who owns the models and training data?
How do monthly hiring, deployments, hardware funding and collections support 24 months after the raise closes?
What the panel challenged
Keep strong growth in the story. Do not infer dishonest intent. Pre-raise runway cannot disprove a post-raise plan. Fleet improvement is not causal proof of a moat.
Narrative sees a repairable story; the devil requires commercial and cash reconciliation before investment advocacy.

Sources: deck pp 6-7, 10-11; CSV rows 2, 11-14; data-room README. See pitch-review.md for the full 42-claim inventory, 53 numerical checks and exact methodological limits. All company data are invented.
